title: Volvo 電動公車系統
summary: 以「Volvo 電動公車系統」為案例，逐步分析電動公車的載客、停站與場站補能。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用。
summaryEn: Use Volvo electric-bus systems to analyze Passenger load, stops and depot charging of an electric bus. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 使用需求與試驗邊界｜Volvo 電動公車系統：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | Volvo electric-bus systems: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜Volvo 電動公車系統 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | Volvo electric-bus systems and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：電動公車的載客、停站與場站補能。本單元觀察 車門、人流、電池、冷卻及場站 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Passenger load, stops and depot charging of an electric bus. In doors, passenger flow, battery, cooling and depot, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 Volvo 電動公車系統 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 15300 kg、載荷 2700 kg。 計算結果 = 18000 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Volvo electric-bus systems. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 15300 kg and payload 2700 kg. Result = 18000 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 車門、人流、電池、冷卻及場站，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. Link evidence to this case’s doors, passenger flow, battery, cooling and depot; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 Volvo 電動公車系統 的原廠或實測規格。e_person=E/(N d)；假設旅程 E=30 kWh、乘員 N=40、距離 d=20 km。 計算結果 = 0.0375 kWh/(person·km)。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
只比較車輛每公里電耗就能完整判斷公共運輸效率。
大型車每公里能耗高但每人公里較低時，檢查載客率是否同條件；極低載客會反轉結論。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Vehicle electricity per km fully describes public-transport efficiency.
When a larger vehicle consumes more per vehicle-km but less per passenger-km, check matched occupancy; very low occupancy can reverse the conclusion.
quiz.explanation: 大型車每公里能耗高但每人公里較低時，檢查載客率是否同條件；極低載客會反轉結論。 明確區分乘客、人員與載重；比較滿載、半載及空駛，不用不同時段載客率直接比較車型。 將證據連回本案例的 車門、人流、電池、冷卻及場站，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: When a larger vehicle consumes more per vehicle-km but less per passenger-km, check matched occupancy; very low occupancy can reverse the conclusion. Distinguish passengers, crew and payload; compare full, half and empty operation without using mismatched occupancy periods to rank vehicles. Link evidence to this case’s doors, passenger flow, battery, cooling and depot; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.
